# Observability errors and warnings

Diagnostics reported by Metalama.Patterns.Observability.

| Article | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| <xref:lama5150> | A class with an existing PropertyChanged event has no overridable OnPropertyChanged method. |
| <xref:lama5151> | The InpcDiagnosticCommentVerbosity project property has an invalid value. |
| <xref:lama5152> | The type of an observable field or property is a struct that implements INotifyPropertyChanged. |
| <xref:lama5154> | An observable class has a virtual property, which the [Observable] aspect doesn't support. |
| <xref:lama5155> | An observable type declares a field or property that hides a base member with the `new` modifier. |
| <xref:lama5156> | A class that already implements `INotifyPropertyChanged` has no `OnPropertyChanged(string)` method the aspect can call. |
| <xref:lama5161> | A property depends on a member of a child object whose type doesn't implement `INotifyPropertyChanged`. |
| <xref:lama5162> | A computed property calls a method that isn't known to be constant. |
| <xref:lama5163> | A computed property reads a child of another computed property, or a property of a base type that doesn't implement INotifyPropertyChanged. |
| <xref:lama5164> | A computed property reads a field that can't be observed, such as a public or static field. |
| <xref:lama5165> | The getter of a computed property declares a local variable of a type that isn't immutable. |
